content.comment_body: I have a [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] and I'm interested in upgrading to [version_no] to benefit from the new features and fixes. Is it possible to update by downloading the correct firmware, or must I replace the module with a newer [product_name] [version_no] device? I would also like to know if programs created for [version_no] will function properly on [version_no] should I choose to replace the device. Any advice on upgrading would be appreciated.

No, this isn't possible. Firmware upgrades are only supported within the same series (e.g., from V1.83.x to V1.83.y), but not between V1.83.x and V1.84.x. Additionally, if you use [product_name] [version_no] and select [version_no] in the software, programs originally developed for [version_no] will run on [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user asked about upgrading from [product_name] [version_no] to [version_no], questioning if a firmware update is sufficient and about the compatibility of existing programs. The response clarified that hardware replacement is necessary for version upgrades; firmware alone won't suffice. Programs written for the older version will continue to work on the newer one if the correct version is selected in the corresponding software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a simple firmware upgrade to obtain the latest version, and wants assurance that previously created programs will remain compatible on the updated hardware.
